verses.original: Παῦλος κλητὸς ἀπόστολος Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ διὰ θελήματος Θεοῦ καὶ ὁ ἀδελφὸς Σωσθένης
verses.transliteration: Paulos klētos apostolos Christou Iēsou dia thelēmatos Theou kai ho adelphos Sōsthenēs
verses.literal: Paul called [to be] an apostle of Christ Jesus by [the] will of God and [our] brother Sosthenes

verses.original: Τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ τοῦ Θεοῦ τῇ οὔσῃ ἐν Κορίνθῳ ἡγιασμένοις ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ κλητοῖς ἁγίοις σὺν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἐν παντὶ τόπῳ ἐπικαλουμένοις τὸ ὄνομα ἡμῶν τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ αὐτῶν καὶ ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: Tē ekklēsia tou Theou tē ousē en Korinthō hēgiasmenois en Christō Iēsou klētois hagiois syn pasin tois en panti topō epikaloumenois to onoma hēmōn tou Kyriou Iēsou Christou autōn kai hēmōn
verses.literal: To the church - of God - - in Corinth [to those] sanctified in Christ Jesus [and] called [to be] holy together with all those vvv vvv everywhere [who] call on the name of our - Lord Jesus Christ their [Lord] and ours

verses.original: Χάρις καὶ εἰρήνη ὑμῖν ἀπὸ Θεοῦ ἡμῶν Πατρὸς καὶ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: Charis kai eirēnē hymin apo Theou hēmōn Patros kai Kyriou Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and [the] Lord Jesus Christ

verses.original: Εὐχαριστῶ πάντοτε μου τῷ Θεῷ περὶ ὑμῶν ἐπὶ τῇ χάριτι τοῦ Θεοῦ τῇ δοθείσῃ ὑμῖν ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: Eucharistō pantote mou tō Theō peri hymōn epi tē chariti tou Theou tē dotheisē hymin en Christō Iēsou
verses.literal: I always thank . . . my - God for you because of the grace - [He] - has given you in Christ Jesus

verses.original: ὅτι ἐν αὐτῷ ἐπλουτίσθητε ἐν παντὶ ἐν παντὶ λόγῳ καὶ πάσῃ γνώσει
verses.transliteration: hoti en autō eploutisthēte en panti en panti logō kai pasē gnōsei
verses.literal: For in Him you have been enriched in every way in all speech and all knowledge

verses.original: καθὼς τὸ μαρτύριον τοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐβεβαιώθη ἐν ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: kathōs to martyrion tou Christou ebebaiōthē en hymin
verses.literal: because [our] testimony about Christ was confirmed in you

verses.original: ὥστε ὑμᾶς μὴ ὑστερεῖσθαι ἐν μηδενὶ χαρίσματι ἀπεκδεχομένους τὴν ἀποκάλυψιν ἡμῶν τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: hōste hymas mē hystereisthai en mēdeni charismati apekdechomenous tēn apokalypsin hēmōn tou Kyriou Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: Therefore you vvv do not lack . . . [any] spiritual gift as you eagerly await the revelation of our - Lord Jesus Christ

verses.original: καὶ ὃς βεβαιώσει ὑμᾶς ἕως τέλους ἀνεγκλήτους ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἡμῶν τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai hos bebaiōsei hymas heōs telous anenklētous en tē hēmera hēmōn tou Kyriou Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: - [He] will sustain you to [the] end [so that you will be] blameless on the day of our - Lord Jesus Christ

verses.original: ὁ Θεὸς δι’ οὗ ἐκλήθητε εἰς κοινωνίαν αὐτοῦ τοῦ Υἱοῦ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ἡμῶν τοῦ Κυρίου πιστὸς
verses.transliteration: ho Theos di’ hou eklēthēte eis koinōnian autou tou Huiou Iēsou Christou hēmōn tou Kyriou pistos
verses.literal: - God - who has called you into fellowship with His - Son Jesus Christ our - Lord [is] faithful

verses.original: δὲ Παρακαλῶ ὑμᾶς ἀδελφοί διὰ τοῦ ὀνόματος ἡμῶν τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ἵνα πάντες λέγητε τὸ αὐτὸ καὶ ᾖ μὴ σχίσματα ἐν ὑμῖν δὲ ἦτε κατηρτισμένοι ἐν τῷ αὐτῷ νοῒ καὶ ἐν τῇ αὐτῇ γνώμῃ
verses.transliteration: de Parakalō hymas adelphoi dia tou onomatos hēmōn tou Kyriou Iēsou Christou hina pantes legēte to auto kai ē mē schismata en hymin de ēte katērtismenoi en tō autō noi kai en tē autē gnōmē
verses.literal: - I appeal to you brothers in the name of our - Lord Jesus Christ that all of you agree together . . . . . . [so that] there may be no divisions among you and [that] you may be united in - - mind and - - - conviction

verses.original: γάρ μου ἀδελφοί ὑπὸ τῶν Χλόης ἐδηλώθη μοι περὶ ὑμῶν ὅτι εἰσιν ἔριδες ἐν ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: gar mou adelphoi hypo tōn Chloēs edēlōthē moi peri hymōn hoti eisin erides en hymin
verses.literal: - My brothers - some from Chloe’s household have informed me - - that there are quarrels among you

verses.original: δὲ λέγω τοῦτο ὅτι ἕκαστος ὑμῶν λέγει Ἐγὼ μέν εἰμι Παύλου δὲ Ἐγὼ Ἀπολλῶ δὲ Ἐγὼ Κηφᾶ δὲ Ἐγὼ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: de legō touto hoti hekastos hymōn legei Egō men eimi Paulou de Egō Apollō de Egō Kēpha de Egō Christou
verses.literal: - What I mean [is] this - Individuals among you are saying I - [follow] Paul - I [follow] Apollos - I [follow] Cephas [or] I [follow] Christ

verses.original: ὁ Χριστός Μεμέρισται Παῦλος μὴ ἐσταυρώθη ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν ἢ ἐβαπτίσθητε εἰς τὸ ὄνομα Παύλου
verses.transliteration: ho Christos Memeristai Paulos mē estaurōthē hyper hymōn ē ebaptisthēte eis to onoma Paulou
verses.literal: - {Is} Christ divided {Was} Paul vvv crucified for you - Were you baptized into the name of Paul

verses.original: εὐχαριστῶ τῷ θεῷ ὅτι ἐβάπτισα οὐδένα ὑμῶν εἰ μὴ Κρίσπον καὶ Γάϊον
verses.transliteration: eucharistō tō theō hoti ebaptisa oudena hymōn ei mē Krispon kai Gaion
verses.literal: I thank - God that I did not baptize any . . . of you except . . . Crispus and Gaius

verses.original: ἵνα μή τις εἴπῃ ὅτι ἐβαπτίσθητε εἰς ἐμὸν τὸ ὄνομα
verses.transliteration: hina mē tis eipē hoti ebaptisthēte eis emon to onoma
verses.literal: so no one can say that you were baptized into my - name

verses.original: δὲ καὶ ἐβάπτισα τὸν οἶκον Στεφανᾶ λοιπὸν οὐκ οἶδα εἴ ἐβάπτισα τινα ἄλλον
verses.transliteration: de kai ebaptisa ton oikon Stephana loipon ouk oida ei ebaptisa tina allon
verses.literal: Yes vvv I also baptized the household of Stephanas beyond that vvv I do not remember if I baptized anyone else

verses.original: γὰρ Χριστὸς οὐ ἀπέστειλέν με βαπτίζειν ἀλλὰ εὐαγγελίζεσθαι οὐκ ἐν λόγου σοφίᾳ ἵνα μὴ ὁ σταυρὸς τοῦ Χριστοῦ κενωθῇ
verses.transliteration: gar Christos ou apesteilen me baptizein alla euangelizesthai ouk en logou sophia hina mē ho stauros tou Christou kenōthē
verses.literal: For Christ {did} not send me to baptize but to preach the gospel not with words of wisdom lest . . . the cross of Christ be emptied of [its] power

verses.original: γὰρ Ὁ λόγος ὁ τοῦ σταυροῦ ἐστίν μωρία τοῖς μὲν ἀπολλυμένοις δὲ ἡμῖν τοῖς σῳζομένοις ἐστιν δύναμις Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: gar Ho logos ho tou staurou estin mōria tois men apollymenois de hēmin tois sōzomenois estin dynamis Theou
verses.literal: For the message - of the cross is foolishness to those who - are perishing but to us who - are being saved it is [the] power of God

verses.original: γάρ γέγραπται Ἀπολῶ τὴν σοφίαν τῶν σοφῶν καὶ τὴν σύνεσιν τῶν συνετῶν ἀθετήσω
verses.transliteration: gar gegraptai Apolō tēn sophian tōn sophōn kai tēn synesin tōn synetōn athetēsō
verses.literal: For it is written I will destroy the wisdom of the wise - the intelligence of the intelligent I will frustrate

verses.original: Ποῦ σοφός ποῦ γραμματεύς ποῦ συζητητὴς τούτου τοῦ αἰῶνος οὐχὶ ὁ Θεὸς ἐμώρανεν τὴν σοφίαν τοῦ κόσμου
verses.transliteration: Pou sophos pou grammateus pou syzētētēs toutou tou aiōnos ouchi ho Theos emōranen tēn sophian tou kosmou
verses.literal: Where [is the] wise [man] Where [is] [the] scribe Where [is] [the] philosopher of this - age {Has} not - God made foolish the wisdom of the world

verses.original: γὰρ ἐπειδὴ ἐν τῇ σοφίᾳ τοῦ Θεοῦ ὁ κόσμος διὰ τῆς σοφίας οὐκ ἔγνω τὸν Θεόν ὁ Θεὸς εὐδόκησεν διὰ τῆς μωρίας τοῦ κηρύγματος σῶσαι τοὺς πιστεύοντας
verses.transliteration: gar epeidē en tē sophia tou Theou ho kosmos dia tēs sophias ouk egnō ton Theon ho Theos eudokēsen dia tēs mōrias tou kērygmatos sōsai tous pisteuontas
verses.literal: For since in the wisdom - of God the world through [its] wisdom {did} not know - [Him] - God was pleased through the foolishness of what was preached to save those who believe

verses.original: Ἐπειδὴ καὶ Ἰουδαῖοι αἰτοῦσιν σημεῖα καὶ Ἕλληνες ζητοῦσιν σοφίαν
verses.transliteration: Epeidē kai Ioudaioi aitousin sēmeia kai Hellēnes zētousin sophian
verses.literal: - - Jews demand signs and Greeks search for wisdom

verses.original: δὲ ἡμεῖς κηρύσσομεν Χριστὸν ἐσταυρωμένον σκάνδαλον μὲν Ἰουδαίοις δὲ μωρίαν ἔθνεσιν
verses.transliteration: de hēmeis kēryssomen Christon estaurōmenon skandalon men Ioudaiois de mōrian ethnesin
verses.literal: but we preach Christ crucified a stumbling block - to Jews and foolishness to Gentiles

verses.original: δὲ αὐτοῖς τοῖς κλητοῖς τε Ἰουδαίοις καὶ Ἕλλησιν Χριστὸν δύναμιν Θεοῦ καὶ σοφίαν Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: de autois tois klētois te Ioudaiois kai Hellēsin Christon dynamin Theou kai sophian Theou
verses.literal: but to those who are called both Jews and Greeks Christ [the] power of God and [the] wisdom of God

verses.original: Ὅτι τὸ μωρὸν τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐστίν σοφώτερον τῶν ἀνθρώπων καὶ τὸ ἀσθενὲς τοῦ Θεοῦ ἰσχυρότερον τῶν ἀνθρώπων
verses.transliteration: Hoti to mōron tou Theou estin sophōteron tōn anthrōpōn kai to asthenes tou Theou ischyroteron tōn anthrōpōn
verses.literal: For the foolishness - of God is wiser - than man’s [wisdom] and the weakness - of God [is] stronger - than man’s [strength]

verses.original: γὰρ ἀδελφοί Βλέπετε ὑμῶν τὴν κλῆσιν ὅτι οὐ πολλοὶ σοφοὶ κατὰ σάρκα οὐ πολλοὶ δυνατοί οὐ πολλοὶ εὐγενεῖς
verses.transliteration: gar adelphoi Blepete hymōn tēn klēsin hoti ou polloi sophoi kata sarka ou polloi dynatoi ou polloi eugeneis
verses.literal: - Brothers consider [ the time of ] your - calling - Not many [of you] [were] wise by human standards . . . not many [were] powerful not many [were] of noble birth

verses.original: ἀλλὰ Θεός ἐξελέξατο τὰ μωρὰ τοῦ κόσμου ὁ ἵνα καταισχύνῃ τοὺς σοφούς καὶ Θεός ἐξελέξατο τὰ ἀσθενῆ τοῦ κόσμου ὁ ἵνα καταισχύνῃ τὰ ἰσχυρά
verses.transliteration: alla Theos exelexato ta mōra tou kosmou ho hina kataischynē tous sophous kai Theos exelexato ta asthenē tou kosmou ho hina kataischynē ta ischyra
verses.literal: But God chose the foolish things of the world - to shame the wise - God chose the weak things of the world - to shame the strong

verses.original: ὁ Θεός ἐξελέξατο καὶ τὰ ἀγενῆ καὶ ἐξουθενημένα τὰ τοῦ κόσμου καὶ τὰ ὄντα μὴ ἵνα καταργήσῃ τὰ ὄντα
verses.transliteration: ho Theos exelexato kai ta agenē kai exouthenēmena ta tou kosmou kai ta onta mē hina katargēsē ta onta
verses.literal: - [He] chose - the lowly and despised things of the world and the things that are not to nullify the things that are

verses.original: ὅπως μὴ πᾶσα σὰρξ καυχήσηται ἐνώπιον τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: hopōs mē pasa sarx kauchēsētai enōpion tou Theou
verses.literal: so that no vvv [one] may boast in [His] presence . . . . . .

verses.original: δὲ Ἐξ αὐτοῦ ὑμεῖς ἐστε ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ ὃς ἐγενήθη ἡμῖν σοφία ἀπὸ Θεοῦ τε δικαιοσύνη καὶ ἁγιασμὸς καὶ ἀπολύτρωσις
verses.transliteration: de Ex autou hymeis este en Christō Iēsou hos egenēthē hēmin sophia apo Theou te dikaiosynē kai hagiasmos kai apolytrōsis
verses.literal: [It is] because of Him [that] you are in Christ Jesus who has become for us wisdom from God - [our] righteousness - holiness and redemption

verses.original: ἵνα καθὼς γέγραπται Ὁ καυχώμενος καυχάσθω ἐν Κυρίῳ
verses.transliteration: hina kathōs gegraptai Ho kauchōmenos kauchasthō en Kyriō
verses.literal: Therefore as it is written {Let} him who boasts boast in [the] Lord
